description: This file defines a specialized Composable function for rendering Markdown content in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes parsing Markdown via the commonmark library, handling various Markdown structures (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, code blocks, images), applying styling, and managing images embedded as base64 data URIs. Its unique focus is on rendering rich Markdown content within a chat UI component.

methods.name: ChatMarkdown
methods.description: Main Composable function that parses Markdown text and renders it as styled Compose UI elements.

methods.name: RenderMarkdownBlocks
methods.description: Recursively processes parsed Markdown nodes to render various block types like headings, paragraphs, lists, code blocks, and tables.

methods.name: RenderParagraph
methods.description: Renders a paragraph node, handling inline images embedded as base64 data URIs.

methods.name: RenderBulletList
methods.description: Renders unordered lists with proper indentation.

methods.name: RenderListItem
methods.description: Renders individual list items, including task list markers.

methods.name: RenderTableBlock
methods.description: Renders Markdown tables with header and cell styling.

methods.name: buildTableRows
methods.description: Builds internal representations of table rows from Markdown nodes.

methods.name: readTableSection
methods.description: Reads header or body sections of tables.

methods.name: readTableRow
methods.description: Reads a single table row into a structured format.

methods.name: buildInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Converts Markdown nodes into an AnnotatedString with styles.

methods.name: appendInlineNode
methods.description: Recursively appends styled text for different Markdown inline nodes.

methods.name: buildPlainText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from Markdown nodes.

methods.name: standaloneDataImage
methods.description: Detects standalone images embedded as Markdown images with data URIs.

methods.name: parseDataImageDestination
methods.description: Parses the destination URL of a Markdown image as a base64 data URI.

methods.name: headingStyle
methods.description: Returns style configurations based on heading level.

methods.name: InlineBase64Image
methods.description: Renders an inline image from base64-encoded data URI.
